{{Top|leg}}
A '''tractor anchorline''' was a form of modern technology sometimes used in suspending cities.<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

Upon arriving at the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] city of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was surprised to learn that Wookiee villages were not suspended by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]], [[Unipod|unipods]], tractor anchorlines or any other clever schemes of modern technology, but by the sheer strength or [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr tree]] branches.<ref name="Heir" />
